note: Faithful labels, injective iota_d, covering images, surjective pi_quo, one acting field, probability measure of full support (IsOpenPosMeasure), permutation symmetry and smoothness on separated configurations for every zeta (Option Character), continuity in the phase and the mixture integral all appear with the same quantifiers. The structure also holds the Q2 and Q4 clauses, treated at Definitions 8.3 and 8.5.

def separated (n : ℕ) : Opens (Points n) :=
  ⟨{x | Function.Injective x.ofLp}, by
    classical
    have eqSet : {x : Points n | Function.Injective x.ofLp} =
        ⋂ (i : Fin n) (j : Fin n) (_ : i ≠ j), {x : Points n | x i ≠ x j} := by
      ext x
      simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_iInter]
      exact ⟨fun h i j hij => fun he => hij (h he), fun h i j he => by_contra fun hij => h i j hij he⟩
    rw [eqSet]
    apply isOpen_iInter_of_finite; intro i
    apply isOpen_iInter_of_finite; intro j
    apply isOpen_iInter_of_finite; intro _
    exact isOpen_ne_fun (PiLp.continuous_apply _ _ i) (PiLp.continuous_apply _ _ j)⟩
